Witkoff met Russia's President Vladimir Putin in the city of St Petersburg on Wednesday - a day after meeting Ukraine's leader. Three-way talks were paused in February, after which Russia stepped up attacks as Ukraine ran out of Western-supplied interceptors to defend against missiles. Firefighters tackled blazes across the Ukrainian capital Speaking on Wednesday, Trump said: "The other day I was talking to Vladimir Putin about settling his war with Ukraine, which I think we're getting closer to, by the way, maybe now the closest we've been." It is not clear what specific proposals Witkoff brought to Putin, but Zelensky said after the talks that "strong" security guarantees for Ukraine and energy ceasefire proposals had been discussed. Putin's aide Yuri Ushakov said their ideas were not very "useful". Top officials from Russia, Ukraine and the US have held several rounds of talks aimed at ending the war. Russia blamed last month's "massive" Ukrainian strikes during its general elections for their disruption. Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, and Moscow currently controls about 20% of Ukrainian territory. The latest talks between Putin (right) and Witkoff lasted about three hours in St Petersburg Speaking to reporters after Wednesday's talks in St Petersburg, Ushakov suggested that a new round could be held around 10 November in Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates. He stressed that the talks must focus on "building a security system for Russia and Ukraine after the end of the conflict." Ushakov also told reporters that Putin reiterated to Witkoff that Russian troops were advancing everywhere across the vast front line and had a "strategic initiative". Ukraine and its European allies have disputed Putin's claim, pointing to a virtual stalemate on the front. On Wednesday, Zelensky said he would accept a deal that would freeze the war along the current front line. "We call it 'ceasefire' or 'stop killings' like President Trump called it. Freeze and stop. And of course this is minimum what we need from Russia today," he told Fox News, adding that security guarantees for Ukraine could be discussed after this. Watch: Zelensky says US military intelligence sharing "works now" Witkoff described the latest talks as "constructive", while Kushner, who was participating via a video link, said: "There is still hard work ahead, but we have a real opportunity to move beyond this war and build a framework for lasting peace, security, and prosperity for generations to come." The talks were held amid a growing row between Ukraine and the US. Trump has said it is time for Ukraine to get a new president, and most recently "for somebody else to negotiate on behalf of Ukraine". He has blamed Ukraine's attacks on Russian oil refineries for fuel prices which have been rising since the start of the US-led war on Iran. He was also heavily criticised by Democratic and some Republican lawmakers after lifting sanctions on Russia - allowing it to release tonnes of diesel "to the American and global marketplace". That was despite signing legislation to authorise fresh US sanctions and tariffs on nations that import Russian oil and gas just weeks earlier. Zelensky - and Ukraine's European allies - criticised Trump's move. Last week, Kyiv accused Washington of withholding critical intelligence to warn Ukrainians about incoming Russian ballistic missile launches, resulting in many civilian deaths. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Tuesday rejected such accusations as "scandalous", and Zelensky said after the Oslo talks that intelligence sharing "works now" . Ukraine's military has also complained of speed restrictions to the US satellite internet network Starlink, which constricted its ability to use drones to conduct strikes against Russia. US officials have denied having requested such a slowdown and a bipartisan group of US senators has called for an urgent investigation . Hubbard had been in jail in Russia for allegedly fighting for Ukraine Before the Putin-Witkoff talks started, Russia released Stephen Hubbard, a 74-year-old American citizen who had been given a jail sentence of nearly seven years for allegedly fighting on behalf of Ukraine. Trump said the former teacher was "on his way back home" and "there was no 'swap' necessary", while Witkoff called Putin a "humanitarian" for agreeing the release. When asked by a BBC reporter whether he agreed with such a description of the Kremlin leader, US Vice-President JD Vance said: "I agree with Steve Witkoff saying something nice to a person who just released an American hostage. "Whether you agree with the underlying sentiment or not, Steve Witkoff is a diplomat. His job is to go over there and get a job done. I care much less about what Steve said than about the fact that he is bringing an American hostage home to his family." news.story_lead: Mission LiFE (Lifestyle for Environment) is a global initiative led by India to promote sustainable individual and community action against climate change. Designed to replace mindless resource consumption with mindful utilization, the initiative focuses on actionable behavioral shifts to protect global ecosystems.
news.full_article_text:
Mission LiFE (Lifestyle for Environment) Key Overview

Mission LiFE is conceptualized as a global mass movement that aims to transform individual actions into macro-level climate interventions. The core philosophy of the initiative is to shift societal economic practices from a traditional 'use-and-dispose' linear model to a sustainable circular economy.

Core Operational Themes

1. Saving Energy: Promoting energy efficiency in households and institutions to reduce personal carbon emissions.
2. Saving Water: Practicing conservation and eliminating water wastage in everyday routines.
3. Reducing Single-Use Plastics: Phasing out disposable plastic items to minimize terrestrial and marine pollution.
4. Adopting Sustainable Food Systems: Encouraging local, seasonal, and organic diets while reducing food waste.
5. Waste Reduction (Swachhata Actions): Implementing systematic waste segregation, reduction, and recycling.
6. Healthy Lifestyles: Aligning daily living habits with natural ecological cycles.
7. E-Waste Management: Ensuring responsible disposal and recycling of electronic components.

Implementation Model

The initiative works through a three-phase strategy: driving consumer demand via individual actions, influencing industry supply through sustainable production shifts, and shaping policy frameworks to institutionalize eco-friendly behaviors globally.

hindi_translation.story_lead: मिशन लाइफ (पर्यावरण के लिए जीवन शैली) जलवायु परिवर्तन से निपटने के लिए व्यक्तिगत और सामुदायिक कार्रवाई को बढ़ावा देने की भारत द्वारा शुरू की गई एक वैश्विक पहल है। इसका उद्देश्य संसाधनों के अंधाधुंध उपयोग को विवेकपूर्ण उपभोग में बदलना है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
मिशन लाइफ (पर्यावरण के लिए जीवन शैली) का मुख्य अवलोकन

मिशन लाइफ एक वैश्विक जन आंदोलन के रूप में परिकल्पित है, जिसका उद्देश्य व्यक्तिगत व्यवहार में बदलाव के माध्यम से पर्यावरण संरक्षण को बढ़ावा देना है। इसका मुख्य विचार पारंपरिक 'उपयोग करो और फेंको' मॉडल को समाप्त कर एक टिकाऊ चक्रीय अर्थव्यवस्था को अपनाना है।

प्रमुख विषय:
1. ऊर्जा की बचत
2. जल संरक्षण
3. एकल-उपयोग प्लास्टिक में कमी
4. टिकाऊ खाद्य प्रणालियों को अपनाना
5. अपशिष्ट में कमी और स्वच्छता
6. स्वस्थ जीवन शैली
7. ई-कचरा प्रबंधन

कार्यान्वयन के चरण:
यह पहल तीन चरणों में काम करती है: मांग में बदलाव, आपूर्ति में परिवर्तन, और नीतिगत ढांचे का निर्माण।
bullet_points: मिशन लाइफ का अर्थ पर्यावरण के लिए जीवन शैली है।
यह पहल संसाधनों के चक्रीय उपयोग पर जोर देती है।
इसमें ऊर्जा, जल, खाद्य और कचरा प्रबंधन से जुड़े सात मुख्य विषय शामिल हैं।
इसका लक्ष्य 'प्रो-प्लैनेट पीपल' (P3) का एक वैश्विक नेटवर्क तैयार करना है।
key_facts: मिशन लाइफ का पूरा नाम 'लाइफस्टाइल फॉर एनवायरनमेंट' है।
यह व्यक्तिगत व्यवहार में बदलाव के माध्यम से पर्यावरण संरक्षण पर केंद्रित है।
यह सात प्रमुख कार्यात्मक क्षेत्रों को कवर करता है।
